recommendations.target: Heavy Duty Drying Towel – 1200gsm product page
recommendations.finding: Current product evidence and search results show a real drying-towel choice problem, including questions about waffle weave, professional practice and suitable formats.
recommendations.why: An existing relevant page can be made clearer for the observed commercial-investigation intent before creating a new page.
recommendations.intervention: Improve the existing product page with an evidence-bounded comparison of use case, size, construction terminology and handling; link to the relevant wash/dry range.
recommendations.outcome: A clearer product decision and better qualified organic landing experience.
recommendations.wrong_if: The page is already the best destination for the relevant cluster, or stock/supply constraints make additional demand undesirable.

recommendations.finding: The catalogue contains drying towels, wash/dry kits, wash mitts and glass/detailing products that can form a coherent task-based path.
recommendations.why: The opportunity is structural and does not require assuming that a new article is the right intervention.
recommendations.intervention: Add validated contextual links between the existing wash, dry and kit pages, using descriptive anchors and preserving existing hierarchy.
recommendations.outcome: Readers and crawlers can move from wash intent to drying choice without relying on a new content asset.
missing: Current internal-link graph from a fresh crawl
recommendations.wrong_if: The current live hierarchy already provides equivalent paths or the linked pages are not indexable/current.

recommendations.finding: External SERP evidence contains repeated choice questions around drying towel type, waffle weave and professional practice.
recommendations.why: A resource may answer the cluster if the existing product page cannot carry the comparison without becoming difficult to use.
recommendations.intervention: Only if the existing product/category pages cannot satisfy the cluster, create one concise choice resource that explains options and routes readers to existing products.
recommendations.outcome: A useful decision aid rather than an article-by-default output.
